projects.title: AI documentation review gating system
projects.desc: A five-dimension review architecture where <mark class="anchor">every check must produce a machine-readable artifact</mark> before the agent may act on its results. Scans, a blocking shell hook, and a gap log that turns review misses into new automated checks.
projects.attr: Built on top of my team's agent tooling. The verification layer is the part I designed.

review.label: review · enforcement
review.pre:
artifacts pinned to HEAD
posts denied without them
fails open by design
review.cnote: Knowing when not to gate is the senior half of gating.

projects.title: LangExtract documentation site

projects.desc: A popular LLM extraction library whose entire documentation was one flat README. Rebuilt as a structured Docusaurus site: <mark class="anchor">content model first</mark>, twelve pages, quickstart to API reference.
